verdict.rationale: Steel is browser infrastructure, not tied to any model: its docs list first-party integrations for Gemini Computer Use, Claude Computer Use, and OpenAI Computer Use. It also integrates with provider-agnostic agent frameworks, including Pydantic AI (explicitly described as provider-agnostic), Vercel AI SDK, CrewAI, Browser-Use, AgentKit, and the OpenAI Agents SDK, so developers can bring their own LLM vendor. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that Steel is model-agnostic or supports BYO model, independent or hands-on corroboration of using multiple providers.
